personal.headline: I’m a self-motivated and passionate full-stack and mobile developer with hands-on experience in MERN stack, NestJS, and React Native.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer (Freelance / Personal Projects)
experience.summary: Developing a Café Management System using the MERN stack, implementing features such as order management, table availability, and payment status tracking. Built a Real-Time Chat Application with React and Firebase to enable seamless user communication, focusing on performance and user experience. Built Zilho, a React Native fashion and wardrobe app using Expo + TypeScript, implementing custom UI components including a vertical ruler height picker with haptic feedback, snap-to-tick behavior, and full React Navigation flow (Splash → Onboarding → Login → Home). Developed a NestJS backend with Prisma ORM, JWT/Passport authentication, DTO validation using class-validator, and deployed to Render; configured ESLint with a three-tier rule philosophy for maintainable, production-ready code.
